mergeNote: The receipts array below is the earlier DISC05 dispatch's work and is preserved verbatim — eight resolved Arkansas sources for obligations outside the current roster. Nothing in it was re-derived or edited. The current DISC05 roster (5 AR, 3 UT) resolved no source to an exact identity bound to an exact official address, so it adds no receipt; what it read, and why each reading is evidence rather than a resolution, is recorded under currentRosterDispatch.

currentRosterDispatch.whyZero: A resolved source for this operation means an exact identity bound to an exact official address. None of the eight obligations reached that state. Five documents WERE read to admissible standard, but each was read as evidence about a different obligation — either as the held half of a pair whose missing half is the obligation, or as one of two rival candidates for a label that must not be bound to either. A document read in evidence is not a source resolved, and recording it here would let a downstream reader count five resolutions this lane did not make.
